# Design Atlas

> Design system for OpenStreetMap (`OSMBrasil/design-atlas`).

## Naming Convention

- Framework components (Svelte & React): `Atl*` PascalCase (e.g. `AtlButton`, `AtlAlert`, `AtlTextInput`)
- CSS classes: `.atl-*` kebab-case (e.g. `.atl-button`, `.atl-alert`, `.atl-field`)
- Web Components (Custom Elements): `<atl-*>` kebab-case (e.g. `<atl-button>`, `<atl-alert>`)

## Documentation

- [Development & Naming Convention](docs/development.md#naming-convention)
- [Using Atlas — Developing](apps/docs/using-atlas/developing.md#naming-convention)
